method: Exact own rear source vectors bounded to the label contour and rasterized with physical white-film background. Front source lettering and marks retained;frequency band amended from the current exact U202 official front reference. Converter-only front regulatory-mark color and overlapping-numeral fill repaired against the exact flat proof. Own LoRa and Wi-Fi collar text/colors redrawn to ordinary PNGs from readable supplied-accessory photographs. No photograph pixels/crops or source vectors distributed.
limitations: A candidate source revision differs from the current exact-product front reference;the frequency band follows the current official868–923 print,and is explicitly an amendment rather than an untouched original.
Other-SKU module candidates and packaging artwork are excluded.
Front film Y13.5–25.5mm is above OLED and disjoint from front user tongueY-9.7–-2.6mm/side reset;no static ink lies over a moving cap. Rear film belongs to fixed rear housing.
Body films touch actual native recesses;OLED glass,RGB diffuser,original status guide and real acoustic carrier close apertures independently of ink.
The antenna collar is physical geometry with an optional texture;artwork:false removes print including collar color/letters but preserves all attributes,index and world matrices.
Antenna typography/registration,front amended typeface and film installation are appearance reconstructions.
Private table,URLs,mappings,original vectors,photos,flat proof,conversion tools and intermediates remain outside Git.
rights: Product names,printed designs,marks and trademarks retain their respective rights.
